evaluation.results_summary: As of 04 June 2024, the developer reported that Zion_Alpha achieved the highest SNLI score among open-source Hebrew models, with a score of 84.05, surpassing most models by a large margin.

identity.name: Zion_Alpha
identity.summary: Zion_Alpha is presented as the first REAL Hebrew model in the world.

specifications.model_size: 13.5 GiB of safetensors weights (14,483,498,016 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: The model was fine-tuned using SOTA techniques and insights from underwater basket weaving; it was not fine-tuned for any tasks yet.
training_context.training_data: The model was not fine-tuned for any tasks, but it understands and comprehends Hebrew.
